The bytes now contain both identity requirements from my prior AMEND: mapping-relation identity binds mapping family plus directed source/target axes, and coalescing cannot erase occurrence, epoch, discontinuity, hold, or gap seams. They also absorb scout’s three blocks: PTS/DTS missingness is independent, packet duration is distinguished from container duration, and equal slope alone is explicitly insufficient — coalescing requires contiguous collinear restrictions of the same exact affine function with compatible half-open endpoints. Exact negative courts cover family/direction substitution and seam deletion; typed projection refusal remains distinct. Plan and design record agree.

This is a docs/spec approval only. It grants no runtime implementation, merge, or landing authority.
